_note: Illustrative example: an anonymised App Store-billed AI photo editor with a free tier. Scores follow references/scoring.md; evidence comes from references/evidence.md.
subtitle: Photo & Video · AI tag · freemium · App Store
verdict: Gates sit on the right features, but every lock opens one generic paywall, credits are sold next to the subscription, and payers see the subscribe screen again.

items.pattern: Upgrade screen, never the subscribe paywall
items.test: Show subscribers their current plan and what the top tier adds instead of the subscribe paywall.
items.evidence: Apple HIG: don't encourage a new subscription for current subscribers (rule)

items.pattern: Allowance in the plan, credits as a top-up
items.test: Take credit packs off the first paywall; offer them only to subscribers who run out.
items.evidence: Mojo: +14% new subscription revenue, no rise in AI cost (#U32, strong)

items.pattern: Name the blocked task in the headline
items.test: Each lock opens a sheet headed by its feature ('Remove objects in 4K with Pro').
items.evidence: Memrise: two benefit framings on one locked mode differed 28% (#U1, strong)

items.pattern: Show the meter before the wall
items.test: Put 'x of 10 left this week' under the generate button.
items.evidence: Observed in 17 apps; hypothesis (no public test)

duration_note: Durations assume 30,000 trigger hits a day and 0.29% view -> paid, for a 10% relative change. Illustrative inputs.
